description: This Java class 'ColumnValidator' provides methods for validating database table columns and SQL injection prevention within the Fineract project. It includes functions to verify table and column existence, parse SQL conditions, and ensure query safety.

classes.name: ColumnValidator
classes.description: A utility class for validating database columns and SQL injection safety within the Fineract security infrastructure.

methods.name: validateColumn
methods.description: Validates that specified tables and columns exist in the database.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column names from a ResultSet of database metadata.

methods.name: validateSqlInjection
methods.description: Validates SQL conditions to prevent injection attacks, parsing conditions and verifying table/column references.

methods.name: getTableColumnMap
methods.description: Maps schema tables to their columns based on SQL query parsing.

methods.name: getTableColumnAliasMap
methods.description: Extracts table aliases and their columns from SQL operands.

methods.name: getOperand
methods.description: Extracts operands from SQL conditions based on operators.

methods.name: getOperand (private helper)
methods.description: Helper to extract individual operand strings from conditions.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces SQL operators in conditions with spaced versions for parsing.
